Subject: Initial request — transfer scope, DPA questionnaire and MSA redlines

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement is kicking off the contract packet and we have a few items to align on before we loop Legal: scope of data transfers (US + EU), the DPA questionnaire, and a set of proposed redlines to your MSA and Order Form. I've attached a short questionnaire and a spreadsheet mapping our subprocessor / routing expectations.

Can you confirm:
- Who at Redwood will own the DPA answers (legal or security)?
- Whether Redwood can accept SCCs as amended with a transfer impact addendum?
- A high-level timeline for signoff (we are aiming for 3 weeks).

Files attached: Gravitas_DPA_Questionnaire.xlsx (questions), transfer_matrix.csv (subprocessor mapping).

Appreciate quick confirmation so we can schedule a contract review.

Best,

Emily —

Thanks for sending this over and for the clear checklist. Quick answers up front:
- Primary owner for the DPA replies will be our Legal team (Laura Bennett), with Security (Sean) providing technical evidence.
- We are comfortable using SCCs + a transfer-impact addendum in principle; we'll flag any limited exceptions in our evidence pack.
- Target timeline: internal reviews complete by 06/23, provide draft redlines by 06/24, aim to get countersigned by 07/05 assuming no major carveouts.

Action plan:
1) Laura will do the MSA + Order Form redline pass and return a tracked changes doc.
2) Sean will export the subprocessor inventory and provide KMS/hosting region details for the questionnaire.
3) I'll consolidate and send a single package to you (redlines + evidence) and include a short exception log for any SCCs items.

Attachments I will circulate after Legal passes: MSA_OrderForm_redlines_LB.docx, SCCs-exception-log.csv, Gravitas_DPA_Questionnaire_filled.xlsx.

Can you confirm who on your side will review the technical evidence (security lead name)? Once we know that, Sean will schedule a short call if needed.

Emily / Ben —

Attached is a tracked-changes redline to the MSA and Order Form (MSA_OrderForm_redlines_LB.docx). Key notes:
- We accept SCCs with a transfer impact addendum; however, there are three narrow routing exceptions tied to certain legacy subprocessors (see clause 7.2 comments). We have proposed language that limits liability exposure but preserves contractual commitments.
- Proposed delegation table included in Exhibit B; this maps controller/processor roles per your questionnaire. Please review the delegation assumptions before we finalize.
- We cannot make ongoing KMS/HSM keys available to customers; instead, we propose a KMS integration clause with key encryption controls and audit commitments.

Sean: can you add the hosting region export and a brief note on KV-cache residency for the evidence pack? Emily: if Gravitas needs a full SOC2 + penetration test artifact, we can provide a scoped export via the secure drive link.

Attachments: MSA_OrderForm_redlines_LB.docx (tracked), SCCs-exception-log.csv (summary of exceptions).
